in_arabic.name: كادين
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root كَدِيْنَ (kadīna), meaning to be eager or earnest.

in_urdu.name: کادین
in_urdu.long_meaning: From Arabic origin, transliterated as كادين (Kadīn) in Arabic, it means 'earnest' or 'eager'. In Urdu, it translates to 'زیادہ شاد' (zīyadah shād), meaning 'very happy' or 'extremely joyful', as the name evokes feelings of enthusiasm and eagerness.

in_hindi.name: कादिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Arabic name كادين (Kadīn) translates to 'कादिन' (Kādin) in Hindi. It means 'प्रसन्न' (prasann), which translates to 'happy' or 'content'.

in_pashto.name: كادين
in_pashto.long_meaning: The Arabic name كادين (Kadīn) translates to 'كادين' (Kādin) in Pashto. It means 'ډېره شهود' (dorah shahod), which translates to 'eager' or 'anxious'.
